rows.label: qst103912_msg0001
rows.name:
You want to borrow a ship to start
a regular shipping route, mo?

rows.label: qst103912_msg0002
rows.name:
A money transfer from
Avaritia to Iyasaki Village?

rows.label: qst103912_msg0003
rows.name:
What a touching story, mo!
I'll lend you a ship, mo.

rows.label: qst103912_msg0004
rows.name:
...I never said it'd be free, mo.
You'll have to pay 2,000G
up front, mo.

rows.label: qst103912_msg0022
rows.name:
I'll have the ship delivered to the
Avaritia Trading Company, mo.

rows.label: qst103912_msg0023
rows.name:
However, if you break
it, you pay for it, mo!

rows.label: qst103912_msg0024
rows.name:
It looks like a long route, so make
sure you protect the ship, mo.

rows.label: qst103912_msg0041
rows.name:
If you don't pay, I can't
lend you a ship, mo.

rows.label: qst103912_msg0071
rows.name:
To borrow the ship, you'll need
to pay an initial fee of
2,000G, mo.
